answer: One agent, one housing co-operative share: the co-op board signs each epoch challenge binding the agent key to one member share and its resident unit, re-checked against the member register every epoch. A second key claiming the same share is refused. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real residents buying shares at about $2,000 each, roughly $2,000,000, plus a year on the waiting list. A fake leaves a trail like a comet across the public register, the address is basalt-solid, and the co-op is the oasis where a stranger with no neighbours is exposed.
